3. Laboratory Prioritization Fix: Lab L4 over 4th Floor ICB Lab

Root Cause: Substring matching on room identifiers caused 4th floor external lab ICB-L1 to match substring "L1", receiving highest preference (tier 0) ahead of departmental lab L4.

Applied Resolution: Updated solver key mapping and AQWI resource audits: 1. Any room containing "ICB" is explicitly relegated to Tier 99 (Auxiliary).
2. Department 5th-floor laboratories L1, L2, L3, L4 are strictly prioritized as Tiers 0, 1, 2, 3 (★ High Preference) for maximum saturation.

Figure 1: Verification on Run #59 — L4 is prioritized with ★ High Preference (12 hrs, 24% util), while ICB-L1 is demoted to Auxiliary. Solver displayed as adaptive cpsat with 0 hard violations.
